overview: The Lower Terrace is the public ceremonial space where clan rites begin, festivals gather, and ritual preparations are made before ascending to the Upper Terrace.
history: The terrace was built as the first ceremonial platform of Shar Vahl.
Clan rites traditionally begin on the Lower Terrace before ascending.
Arcane conduits were added to stabilize ritual energy.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the terrace was expanded for larger gatherings.
Shadow-Threat Watch began monitoring ceremonial flares after anomalies.
hooks: A ceremonial flare erupts during a clan rite.
Arcane conduits destabilize under ritual strain.
A festival crowd surge requires immediate coordination.
Shadow corruption is detected near the lower braziers.
